ten_k_highlights: SiTime Corporation designs, develops, and markets a range of high-performance oscillators and clock generators for use in a variety of applications, including high-speed computing, artificial intelligence, and other high-performance applications.
The Company's products are used in a variety of end markets, including data center, artificial intelligence, and other high-performance applications.
SiTime Corporation's revenue has been increasing at a rate of 49.3% per year over the past five years, driven by growing demand for high-performance computing and artificial intelligence.
